description:
Get The Vibe Shipped 50: apps built with AI coding tools ranked by stated, sourced monthly USD revenue.

Use when: the user asks how much vibe-coded apps earn, or for the top-earning apps built with a given tool. Always mention that figures are as stated, with the evidence tier.

Behavior: Read-only. Each entry has rank, stated revenue, evidence tier (A verified / B documented / C claim), revenue date, stale flag, source link and a rank-card image URL. include_unranked adds notable apps that are not ranked, plus methodology.

Example: {"tool":"cursor","limit":10}

tool.description: Only apps built with this tool id, e.g. cursor.
